name: hgi_sm_xq_pegress-x1-COMMIT
purpose: XQL pair-egress leaf: the ctl egress (rw capture, replicated beat select, BD beat capture, xw pins) per SM pair, beside the pair store

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_sm_xload_xq_pegress u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/peers/ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_xql.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: xql_lock_exact
bench.cmd: XLOAD_F20=1 XLOAD_CL2=1 XLOAD_CLOCK_LEAVES=1 XLOAD_XQL=1 XQL_T=2 bash rtl/hbm_accel/generic/adapters/tb/run_xload_static_lock.sh {RUN}/xql_lock_exact
bench.min_count_regex: ^XQL vs cl2f \(\+2 edges, 4 pairs\): [0-9]+ cycles compared, ([0-9]+) pair beats, 0 differ$

bench.name: xql_pair_write_drop_mutant
bench.cmd: XLOAD_F20=1 XLOAD_CL2=1 XLOAD_CLOCK_LEAVES=1 XLOAD_XQL=1 XQL_T=2 XQL_MUT=1 bash rtl/hbm_accel/generic/adapters/tb/run_xload_static_lock.sh {RUN}/xql_m1
bench.fail_regex: ^XQL vs cl2f \(\+2 edges, 4 pairs\): [0-9]+ cycles compared, [0-9]+ pair beats, [1-9][0-9]* differ$

bench.name: xql_pair_skew_mutant
bench.cmd: XLOAD_F20=1 XLOAD_CL2=1 XLOAD_CLOCK_LEAVES=1 XLOAD_XQL=1 XQL_T=2 XQL_MUT=2 bash rtl/hbm_accel/generic/adapters/tb/run_xload_static_lock.sh {RUN}/xql_m2
bench.fail_regex: ^XQL vs cl2f \(\+2 edges, 4 pairs\): [0-9]+ cycles compared, [0-9]+ pair beats, [1-9][0-9]* differ$

bench.name: xql_pair_map_mutant
bench.cmd: XLOAD_F20=1 XLOAD_CL2=1 XLOAD_CLOCK_LEAVES=1 XLOAD_XQL=1 XQL_T=2 XQL_MUT=3 bash rtl/hbm_accel/generic/adapters/tb/run_xload_static_lock.sh {RUN}/xql_m3
bench.fail_regex: ^XQL vs cl2f \(\+2 edges, 4 pairs\): [0-9]+ cycles compared, [0-9]+ pair beats, [1-9][0-9]* differ$

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_sm_xq_pegress/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_sm_xq_pegress/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_sm_xq_pegress --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_sm_xload_xq_pegress  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
